posts.name: Anirudh Phophalia
posts.cooked:
I want to make into notice that during my OPPE exam I faced several issues in submitting the 5th question. Whenever i tried to submit that question, it appeared like its loading but till 5 minutes no progress was showing in the terminal, so I press ctrl+c to stop the process and did other questions.
After completing the other questions i again tried evaluating the 5th question but it didnt, i was getting the same error again and again.

And i got a message in the VM that if you are unable to submit a question leave it and do other questions it will automatically be evaluated(I am not sure about the wordings of the message but the meaning was this only), so i submitted my test.

But i received only 60 marks which clearly shows that the 5th question was not evaluated although my code was correct.

Please look into this matter and please get it resolved @team system commands

Thanks.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
I have gone through your submission, and your awk script is inherently logically incorrect. It runs a loop in the END block that goes on and on, and does not stop after 7 columns. It keeps on printing 0,0,0,0,0,0,0....

There were other logical issues as well, due to which the answer would anyway be incorrect if it terminated.

You can run your solution on a public test case yourself and see why your code does not evaluate to avoid these confusions.

bash script.sh < /opt/se2001/oppe_1.5/public/test_case_1/input.txt

Screenshot 2025-08-20 at 10.11.261796×1552 356 KB

posts.name: Divyanshu
posts.cooked:
During the OPPE there were several issues as everyone has pointed out. For me I could not evaluate the private cases except for the 1st question as after public cases evaluation the system would just hang, so I would have to kill the process to continue. In synchro status it should 2 private test cases passed for question 1 and 1 for question 2.

My code passed public cases for question 1,2,3 and 5, and I couldn’t check for private cases so I wrote my answers based on the public cases, but I only got 63 in the result. Can I know what went wrong. Is it an evaluation fault or one of my codes failed, if yes then can I know which one and how because the VM OPPE has been closed for us and I don’t have a way of checking it.

Also, if you could clarify what are these 3 marks for?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: This is a misconception. The message stated that if your SUBMISSION is failing, you can move on, as we will resubmit your codes post exam. However if your code itself is wrong, and the output does not match for private test cases, you wont be (and also should not expect) getting any marks for that.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Your Qs3 code only works on one test case, rest are failing, so you have got marks for Qs 1,2,5 and partial marks for Qs3.

24f1002249:

Also, if you could clarify what are these 3 marks for?

The 3 marks are for the third question which had one private test case (out of the 7) which expects a blank output, so even a wrong or empty code will pass that test case. \frac{1}{7}\times20 gives you the 3 marks (rounded up).

posts.cooked: It was passing the public cases so what went wrong in the private one? What was the error in the output?
